Example Google Trends "Interest over time" exports for the parser tests (task 1.14a).

- `classic_layout.csv`, `quoted_layout.csv`: made by hand in the two layouts Google is known to use.
- `time_series_Worldwide_20260725-0228_20261025-0228.csv`: the owner's real export from trends.google.com (2026-10-25, Worldwide, past 90 days). The 2026 layout has bare topic names; the region is in the file name.
